summary.text: Cov Ratcliffe is a Democrat who represents District 28 in the Hawaiʻi House of Representatives, listed in the Legislature's directory as Michael Ratcliffe.
The House Majority Caucus member page describes the district as Sand Island, Iwilei and Chinatown.
